title: Robust color classes in suited proper colorings of exponential graphs
statement_scope: Whole author Claim 2: consider a graph Γ with |V(G)|=n (author notation) and a suited proper c-coloring Ψ of E_c(Γ). Then there is a vertex v=v(Ψ) of Γ such that at least c minus the n-th root of n^3 c^{n−1} color classes Ψ^{-1}(b) are v-robust: for any φ_b in Ψ^{-1}(b), there is w in N(v) with φ_b(w)=b, where N(v) is the closed neighborhood of v in Γ. The author's displayed |V(G)|=n is retained without adding an equality G=Γ.

context_spans.label: Exponential graph and suited coloring definitions

standard_prerequisites: Definition of exponential graph E_c(Γ), suited proper c-coloring, image Im φ, and closed neighborhood N(v).
Observation 1: in a suited proper c-coloring, Ψ(φ) belongs to Im φ.
Elementary pigeonhole principle and finite cardinality estimates for mappings V(Γ)→{1,...,c}.
difficulty_reason: Rule author-work-bearing-core-v1-20261114: H2 because Claim 2 is a nontrivial counting/robustness lemma, not a routine definition. Its proof at counterexample.tex lines 116-127 uses a large-class cardinality estimate, a pigeonhole choice of a class I(u,b), and the observation that a non-large class is too small to cover all selected mappings; primary locator line 113.

difficulty_evidence.bearing_core: Large-class counting argument yielding c−sqrt[n]{n^3c^{n−1}} v-robust color classes.

semantic_comparisons.basis: IP-set translation in arXiv:2412.17868v3 is additive combinatorics; no exponential graph, suited coloring, robust color class, or chromatic tensor product.
Local antimagic total chromatic numbers of firecracker and edge-corona graphs use a different coloring invariant and no exponential-graph robust-class counting.
AVD total chromatic number of graph products is closest only by product terminology; its hypotheses and conclusion concern total colorings, not robust classes in E_c(Γ).
Multidimensional Ramsey monochromatic product cliques use a different quantified structure and conclusion; no suited proper coloring or v-robust class statement.
Kneser-graph orthogonality dimension/minrank is unrelated to the exponential-graph robust-color-class lemma.
